description: For constrained sites where a 1350 m dead-man buffer is not available. Requires a co-located token issuer; the latency gate of [R-C-022] excludes any store-and-forward command path.

rationale.tokenLifetimeS: 1000 + 100 + 50 + 250 = 1400 ms worst case, giving a 330 m buffer at 250 m/s. Buys a tighter site at the cost of requiring a command path with p99 latency under 333 ms per [R-C-022], which effectively means co-location.
rationale.tokenRefreshHz: 10 Hz is inside the GEO round trip and this profile is therefore unsuitable for GEO.
